statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period.
The diagnosis codes on the claim are I34.0 and R42.
The diagnosis codes support the clinical presentation of mitral valve insufficiency and the symptoms prompting the extended rhythm monitoring.
The claim for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on reason code CO-197.
The required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date.
